notes.title: 4 days left for the Eden Genesis release!
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44789401/baf6de5829f7cf16cce69d162001f653171d263c.png[/img]

The launch day is approaching! Eden Genesis will be available on Steam, Xbox and PlayStation on August 6 at 05:00 pm (UTC). The Nintendo Switch version will take a bit more time, aiming for a release in September to ensure the best performance.

Mark August 6 in your calendars, because that's the day you'll be transported to the virtual world of Eden Genesis!

Once again, thanks for being part of this project. See you on the other side, hackers :)

notes.title: Official Release Date for Eden Genesis
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44789401/39c3eaf59248a8e1dfe6e999f40eca1896901d53.jpg[/img]
It's official, you'll be able to put in the shoes of Leah Anderson and help our protagonist fight a deadly disease that is destroying her neurons in a matter of weeks. Keep in mind [b]August 6[/b] of this year because it's the release date of Eden Genesis for [b]Steam, PlayStation 4/5 and Xbox One/Series[/b].

[b]As for the Nintendo version[/b], we can confirm that it is in the Gold phase, we've decided to postpone its launch to [b]September [/b]to ensure that it is the best possible version for Switch, featuring the best performance and controls that feel fluid and smooth.

On the other hand, to liven up the wait, we'd like to share for the first time a video of [b]Elesky playing one of the main themes included in the game on piano[/b]. Remember that Elesky is in charge of adapting and performing all the songs from the Eden Genesis OST composed by Juan Ignacio Teruel. Her versions will be included in the Piano Collection:

[previewyoutube=Gf9hGoEKpps;full][/previewyoutube]
Elesky's collaboration with the dev team promises a [b]Piano Collection full of memorable themes[/b]. Just one look at the video is enough to see the passion that the performer puts into each note and the great quality and care of the music. [b]Both the soundtrack and the Piano Collection[/b] for our cyberpunk platformer [b]are available to add them to your Steam wishlist:[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3048610/Eden_Genesis_Official_Soundtrack/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3048810/Eden_Genesis_Piano_Collection/

Fans of cyberpunk platformers and adventure games must pay close attention to the launch of Eden Genesis. The game offers spectacular graphics, addictive gameplay, dozens of levels to complete, and a deep story that will put us in the shoes of a hacker with a crucial mission for the whole human species. Remember that [b]Eden Genesis features a multiplayer mode[/b] that will allow you to compete with any user regardless of their platform.

Our title will be available on Steam and Xbox and PlayStation consoles on [b]August 6[/b], while it will be released for Nintendo Switch in September, ensuring the best performance and polished control in all its versions. Right now you can add it to your wishlist and even play its demo available on Steam from this link:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2562900/Eden_Genesis/

See you in the virtual world of Eden Genesis!

notes.title: "Most Wanted" Update - 6 Days Left
notes.notes:
Dear players,

There are only a few days left to finish the campaign and we want to show you more details about the incredible “Most Wanted Ghost” reward. It would be great if you don't miss the opportunity to be eternal in Eden Genesis.

[h2][b]What is the “Most Wanted Ghost” reward in Eden Genesis?[/b][/h2]

During the game, Leah will get access to the Eden Genesis central system where the data of the most wanted and dangerous Ghosts on the network is stored. High-ranking hackers whose reward would grant millions to anyone offering information about them. Thanks to this reward you will be one of these Ghosts, becoming part of the game and its story.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44789401/97d412dc32efa7abc40699a87762664331f840ab.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]How is the “Most Wanted Ghost” card created?[/b][/h2]

Our team will ask you for an image of yourself or even a pet, as well as characteristics of the image, references or details that allow us to create together a memorable Ghost file. Since a picture says more than a thousand words, here are some examples.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44789401/273f412062843a935d4fd8732c890ef56a71928d.jpg[/img]

They look amazing, right? Well, it is only possible to be a Ghost in Eden Genesis and become part of our game forever through the “Most Wanted Ghost” reward, whether in its Early or Standard mode. You will also get a Collector's Edition and the digital version of the game, besides the soundtrack and other stuff…

There are only a few days left... We rely on your support to reach the next stretch goal and make Eden Genesis an even better game with your contribution.

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/aeternumgamestudios/eden-genesis-a-cyberpunk-adventure/rewards#reward-UmV3YXJkLVVtVjNZWEprTFRrM01qVTBOams9]See Now Reward "Most Wanted Ghost"[/url]

We are preparing more news for the upcoming days, so stay tuned because the last few days will be frantic.

Thanks for your support!

notes.title: New release date and exclusive rewards confirmed for the Kickstarter!
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44789401/ff182f3110c4c3d1893520a7236c89852799531a.png[/img]
After delaying the Eden Genesis Kickstarter campaign for a few days, we can now confirm the new release date and the new details about the rewards!

We have worked against the clock to offer a limited and numbered edition of Leah's Motorbike that will be created by hand, hand-painted:

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44789401/2a96809d84b99c56e10b0360c0a5642880dfea84.png[/img]

We offer two exclusive rewards only to those who sign up with their email to the Eden Genesis newsletter. These followers will be able to download a new wallpaper and their name will also be included in the game itself as long as they subsequently purchase a Kickstarter reward. 

The Eden Genesis Kickstarter campaign will begin on April 2. Here is a link to register your email:

https://www.backerkit.com/call_to_action/ebeab4d9-6000-4677-bb43-cb01f8b104ea/landing


Thanks for your support!
